subject: Renewal + EU onramp + APAC pilot — proposal & SLO topup
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lucie Martin <lucie@medisphere.eu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + EU onramp + APAC pilot — proposal & timeline

Hi Lucie,

Following up on our renewal conversation — thanks again for the candid feedback last week. Attached is a short proposal (initial_proposal_v2.pdf) that stitches together three asks we heard from Medisphere: (1) formalize the renewal term and committed throughput, (2) add an EU-dedicated onramp (single-tenant option) to meet jurisdictional requirements, and (3) run a 90-day APAC pilot for burst capacity and warm-standby failover.

High-level summary: 
- Term: 12 or 24 months (we've priced both; see SOW options).
- EU onramp: dedicated tenancy in our Frankfurt region with tenant-level key management (customer KMS supported). Optional nightly snapshot export for audit.
- APAC pilot: 90 days of warm-standby capacity in Tokyo (staged traffic, 2x baseline token throughput, automated failover policy).
- SLA/top-up: proposed +15% SLO uplift for EU onramp (lower latency SLA, dedicated nodes) — we include credits for under-performance.
- Pricing: incremental commit for EU node + pilot uplift. See attached proposal for line items.

Asks from your side to proceed: 
1) Confirm that tenant-level isolation + customer KMS satisfies your legal/data residency team.
2) Confirm whether the APAC pilot should be configured as warm-standby (reserved cache kept hot) vs. cold standby (on-demand spin-up).
3) Any procurement constraints or e-signature flow we should use (DocuSign preferred).

Next steps I propose: can we schedule a 30-minute technical/ops call next week with your InfoSec and Procurement to validate the SOW and the SOC2 evidence? I can bring Ben (pricing/SOW) and Naomi (onboarding/ops).

If helpful, I can also send an updated SOW that breaks pricing into 12/24 month scenarios.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: initial_proposal_v2.pdf

From: Lucie Martin <lucie@medisphere.eu>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@medisphere.eu, procurement@medisphere.eu
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU onramp + APAC pilot — proposal & timeline

Thanks Karthik — I reviewed the PDF quickly and appreciate the clarity. A few immediate clarifying questions from Product and InfoSec: 

1) Data residency granularity: when you say "tenant-level isolation" can you confirm whether customer datasets are logically partitioned on a shared cluster or whether this is a fully dedicated VM/GPU tenancy per customer? Our regulator requires demonstrable controls for instance separation for certain data types.

2) Failover RTO/RPO: for the APAC warm-standby pilot, what is the expected RTO for routing traffic to APAC after a region incident? Is there an automated health-check + global routing cutover that we can test?

3) Audit artifacts: can we get sample runbook entries and the SOC2 evidence references (we'll need them for our audit pack)?

Procurement: we prefer DocuSign for execution but need the legal team to confirm the amendment language on cross-border data processing. I'll loop them once InfoSec confirms the tenancy model.

I attached an internal ops Q doc with the checklist we typically run.

Best,
Lucie
Head of Cloud Integrations — Medisphere Health
lucie@medisphere.eu

Attachment: internal_ops_questions.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lucie Martin <lucie@medisphere.eu>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 16:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU onramp + APAC pilot — proposal & timeline

Hi Lucie — quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) Tenancy model: the EU onramp can be provisioned in two ways: 
   - Dedicated tenancy (single-tenant VPC + reserved GPUs): full isolation, recommended for regulated workloads.
   - Isolated logical tenancy on our multi-tenant cluster with tenant-level encryption keys: lower cost, still meets many residency needs but not the same physical separation guarantee.

2) APAC warm-standby RTO: for the proposed warm-standby config we maintain pre-warmed inference nodes and a hot KV cache for the critical prefix set. In a simulated regional outage we measure routing cutover and request-level failover in under 30 seconds for most endpoints (depends on client DNS TTL); end-to-end session warmness (cache misses) settles over ~2 minutes. We can provision a staged failover runbook and two test windows during the pilot.

3) Audit artifacts & SOC2: Naomi will send a SOC2 snapshot and the onboarding runbook. We also include daily sync logs for the migration window.

SOW & Pricing: I've attached a draft SOW and a short amendment that lays out the 12/24 month fee schedules and the APAC pilot uplift. High-level pricing options: 12-month (baseline + EU node + pilot uplift) or 24-month (baseline + EU node with 10% committed discount). Pilot capacity: recommend 2x baseline token throughput for 90 days, with a one-time top-up credit if you convert to 24 months.

Links: HubSpot deal HSP-12345 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/HSP-12345) — SOW file is in the linked Drive folder.

Next steps: 
- Naomi: will attach SOC2 snapshot & onboarding runbook in a follow-up.
- Karthik / Lucie: if procurement is OK, we'll push the amendment to DocuSign (link below) and schedule a technical pilot kickoff the week after signature.
